notes: The only C++ submission is WA, so there is no accepted reference. orig.cpp is a corpus-written Dijkstra over teleports where a centroid decomposition finds the not-yet-reached vertices within distance D of the settled vertex (each vertex is reached once, the cost of reaching v is its a_v), checked against the statement samples and an independent O(N^2) BFS-plus-Dijkstra brute on 200 random trees (paths, stars, caterpillars, random).
